identifiers.temporary_spare_request: SPR-########; allocator 1..99999999 with 100000000 exhausted sentinel; lexicographic sequence order equals creation-allocation order and values are never reused
identifiers.local_spare_unit: LSU-########; allocator 1..99999999 with exhausted sentinel; established Beta requirement
identifiers.fault_tag: FT-########; allocator 1..99999999 with exhausted sentinel; values never reused
identifiers.official_spare_request: SR followed by exactly seven decimal digits
identifiers.rma: C followed by exactly ten decimal digits

quantities.rule: bounds are technical safety limits, not fulfillment caps; requests above limit require split/review rather than integer overflow or silent truncation

bulk_action_targets.rule: larger operator selection is partitioned into separately confirmed atomic batches with one result per target; no silent truncation

normalization.part_code: PART_CODE_V1 = Unicode NFKC, collapse/trim Unicode whitespace, Unicode casefold; punctuation, hyphens, slashes, accents and internal non-whitespace characters remain significant
normalization.serial_candidate: SERIAL_MATCH_V1 uses same normalization profile and remains candidate evidence only, never physical identity
normalization.official_ids: ASCII exact canonical validation; no fuzzy normalization beyond accepted display-prefix parsing at transport boundary

pagination: All large Inventory lists use deterministic cursor pagination with exact count queries when required by UI/preflight; rendered-page size never becomes business cardinality.
writer_performance: Authoritative transactions use indexed point/existence/quantity checks and bounded participant sets only. Compatibility recommendation, large contributor aggregation preview, duplicate search, communication parsing, artifact generation and bulk preflight occur outside the writer lock.
